CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology Partnership Program: Exclusive Offer for Partners

Join the CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology Partnership Program and Earn 25% Commission!

Are you passionate about skincare and looking to earn money by promoting premium dermatological products? Join the CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology Partnership Program and start earning lucrative commissions today!

Why Partner with CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology?

  • High Commission Rates: Earn an attractive 25% commission on the total cart value of every sale you generate.
  • Quality Products: Promote a wide range of scientifically formulated skincare products that deliver visible results.
  • Reliable Payouts: Receive your earnings on the 15th of every month, with a straightforward net-30 payout schedule.
  • Marketing Support: Access a variety of marketing materials, including banners, product images, and exclusive discounts to help you drive sales.
  • Dedicated Support Team: Get assistance from our dedicated partnership support team to maximize your earning potential.

How It Works

  1. Sign Up: Apply to join the CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology Partnership Program. It's quick, easy, and free!
  2. Promote: Use your unique partnership links to promote CDERMA products on your website, blog, or social media channels.
  3. Earn: Earn a 25% commission on every sale generated through your links. Track your earnings and performance through our user-friendly partner dashboard.
  4. Get Paid: Receive your commissions on the 15th of each month. Commissions are paid on a net-30 basis, ensuring timely and reliable payments.

Key Program Features

  • Generous Commission Structure: Enjoy a substantial 25% commission on all sales.
  • Timely Payouts: Get paid on the 15th of each month with our net-30 payout terms.
  • No Cost to Join: Joining our Partnership Program is completely free.
  • Transparent Reporting: Access real-time reports to monitor your sales, clicks, and earnings.
  • Comprehensive Support: Our team is here to help you succeed with tailored advice and resources.

Important Note

  • Return Policy: If a customer returns a product within 30 days of the payout period, the commission for that sale will be voided. This ensures that you are paid only for successful transactions.

Ready to Get Started?

Sign up today and become a CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology Partner! Start earning commissions by sharing the skincare solutions you love with your audience.

For any questions or assistance, feel free to contact our support team at [Insert Contact Email].

Join us in promoting healthier, glowing skin with CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology!

Partnership Program
Terms and Conditions

Welcome to the CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology Partnership Program. Please read these Terms and Conditions ("Terms", "Terms and Conditions") carefully before participating in our Partnership Program.

1. Introduction

CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology ("we", "our", "us") offers a Partnership Program ("Program") where approved partners ("Partner", "you", "your") can earn commissions by promoting our products and driving sales through their unique partnership links. By joining our Program, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms.

2. Partner Eligibility

To be eligible for the Program, you must:

  • Have a valid and active website, blog, or social media profile.
  • Be at least 18 years old.
  • Comply with all local laws and regulations.

3. Program Structure

3.1 Revenue Share Model

  • Partners will receive 25% of the total cart value of sales generated through their unique partnership links.

3.2 Payout Schedule

  • Payouts are made on the 15th of each month.
  • Commissions are paid on a net-30 basis. For example, commissions earned in January will be paid out on February 15th.

3.3 Payout Method

  • Payouts will be made via the payment method selected during the partner sign-up process (e.g., PayPal, bank transfer).

4. Commission Calculation and Payment

4.1 Commission Earnings

  • Commissions are calculated based on the total cart value of completed sales minus any discounts, taxes, shipping, and handling fees.

4.2 Returns and Cancellations

  • If a customer returns a product within 30 days of the payout period, the commission for that sale will be voided.
  • We reserve the right to adjust or deduct commissions for returned products, chargebacks, or fraudulent transactions.

4.3 Minimum Payout Threshold

  • The minimum payout threshold is $50. If your commission balance is below this amount, it will roll over to the next month until the threshold is met.

5. Partner Responsibilities

5.1 Promotional Methods

  • Partners must use ethical and lawful promotional methods.
  • Prohibited methods include, but are not limited to, spamming, misleading claims, and unauthorized use of our trademarks.

5.2 Content Guidelines

  • Partners must ensure that their promotional content accurately represents our products and complies with all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Partners are responsible for disclosing their partnership relationship with CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology in accordance with FTC guidelines or other relevant regulations.

5.3 Account Management

  • Partners must keep their account information up to date, including contact details and payment information.

6. Termination

6.1 Termination by You

  • You may terminate your participation in the Program at any time by providing written notice to us.

6.2 Termination by Us

  • We reserve the right to terminate your participation in the Program at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice.

6.3 Effect of Termination

  • Upon termination, you will forfeit any unpaid commissions if you have violated these Terms.
  • All licenses granted to you under these Terms will immediately cease.

7. Limitation of Liability

  • We will not be liable for any indirect, special, or consequential damages (or any loss of revenue, profits, or data) arising in connection with these Terms or the Program, even if we have been advised of the possibility of such damages.

8. Changes to Terms

  • We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Any changes will be effective upon posting on our website. Your continued participation in the Program after such changes shall constitute your acceptance of the new Terms.

9. Governing Law

  • These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of [Your State/Country], without regard to its conflict of law principles.

10. Contact Us

If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at:

  • Email: team@cderma.com

By joining the CDERMA by Cellular Dermatology Partnership Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.
